Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:67459
Court No. - 73
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10378 of 2024

Applicant :- Bhup Ram
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Jitendra Pal Singh,Pradeep Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.Counter affidavit filed today on behalf of the State is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Jitendra Pal Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri B.P. Singh, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
205 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Jahanabad, District Pilibhit, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that this is second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant and the first bail application of the applicant who was father in law of the deceased had been dismissed on merit by this Court on 9.8.2023 but about a week before the bail application of co-accused Adesh, Devar of the deceased was allowed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 31.7.2023 but this fact could not be brought to the notice of this Court.

sentences.text: He further submitted that the bail order of co-accused Adesh has been annexed as annexure-6 to the affidavit filed in support to the instant bail application.

6. He further submitted that on the basis of dying declaration of the deceased, the first bail application of the applicant was dismissed and from perusal of the dying declaration of the deceased, it reflects that she also made allegation of ablazing against her devar i.e.
co-accused-Adesh, therefore, the case of applicant is not distinguishable from the case of co-accused Adesh, devar of the deceased.

7. He further submitted that applicant is father in law of the deceased and during trial, witnesses of fact have been declared hostile and in the present matter he is in jail since 30.5.2022 i.e. for almost two years.

8. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is father in law of the deceased and deceased in her dying declaration recorded by Magistrate, concerned categorically stated that applicant and her husband ablazed her and in her dying declaration she also stated that her devar-Adesh was also ablazed her and however, co-accused Adesh, the devar has been released on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 31.7.2023 but from the order dated 31.7.2023 it reflects that it has been obtained by concealing, material facts as in the order dated 31.7.2023, the fact of dying declaration has not be mentioned and it appears that on the ground that all the witnesses of fact have been declared hostile, co-accused Adesh i.e. devar of the deceased was released on bail and therefore, applicant cannot be get benefit of the order of the co-accused Adesh dated 31.7.2023 and therefore, the instant bail applicant is liable to be dismissed.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. From the perusal of the record, it appears that this is the second bail application filed on behalf of the applicant and his first bail application has been dismissed on merit by this Court vide order dated 9.8.2023 and from perusal of the order dated 9.8.2023 it reflects that applicant is however father in law of the deceased but there is dying declaration of the deceased on record, in dying declaration, she specifically stated that applicant ablazed her alongwith other accused.

11. However, from the record it also reflects that the bail application of the applicant was dismissed on 9.8.2023 and about a year before the bail application of the son of applicant i.e. devar of the deceased was allowed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 31.7.2023 and it appears that this fact had not been brought to the notice of this Court but it appears from the order dated 31.7.2023, the bail of co-accused Adesh was allowed on the ground that all the witnesses of fact have been declared hostile and from the entire order dated 31.7.2023, it could not be reflected that there is also dying declaration of the deceased

, therefore, this Court finds force in the argument advanced by learned AGA that it appears that by concealing material facts co-accused Adesh obtained bail and therefore, no benefit can be given under the pretext of the order of the devar of the deceased.

sentences.text: 12. In view of the facts and circumstance of the case, discussed above, I do not find any good ground on the basis of which second bail application of the applicant can be allowed.
13. Accordingly, the instant bail application stands rejected.

14. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
